control.policy: freeze and reuse the completed primary cohort; never rerun or top up control

eligibility: Any attempt with at least one valid model response is canonical. Model aborts and later timeouts remain outcomes; replace only objective provider/transport failures with zero valid responses.

adaptive_rule.6_to_10: extend if absolute fixed-denominator pass-rate difference is at least 2.0 points or strict-completion rates differ
adaptive_rule.10_to_30: extend if the whole-conversation bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero, or absolute difference is at least 3.0 points with an aggregate-aligned same-turn direction recurring in at least three conversations, or strict-completion rates differ
adaptive_rule.gate: each extension requires a frozen local analysis artifact and an explicit extend decision
